remarks: Your search is over.  1st floor primary suite with four bedrooms on second floor. Open floor plan, great for entertaining. Beautiful den with hardwoods, custom built in desk and cabinets. Bright, two story great room with floor to ceiling shelving, wood burning fireplace with stone surround. Custom kitchen cabinets, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances with professional gas stove. Large primary suite with private bath, commode room and large walk-in closet. Relax in the sunroom off the kitchen that overlooks the gorgeous yard with stamped concrete patio, Gunite pool, pool house with bathroom, and private land with extra lots. Endless options for your backyard activities. Formal dining, mudroom and first floor laundry with built in cubbies. Don't miss the loft area that can be accessed by ladder from three second floor rooms. Tons of closet space throughout. Finished basement with bar area with sink, beverage fridge and microwave. Spring of 2026 updates include: Architectural 30-year roof with transferrable warranty, New Sump Pump with backup system with alarm and freshly painted interior.  2 Hot water tanks-2020. Security system, sprinkler system, professionally landscaped throughout. Top rated Williamsville schools within walking distance.  This home has it all, don't miss it! Square footage differs from tax records per appraisers floor plan sketch. Please reference updated survey for lot size.
